_note: What Falcon BMS.cfg does not say about its own options. The list of options, their defaults and most of the
descriptions are read from the BMS version's own stock file by tools/extractor/src/cfgcatalog.mjs — this file
only adds what that file leaves out: which group a line belongs in, a description for the lines BMS does not
comment, the named choices for the few that take one of a set, and the options that are real in 4.38 but are
not written into the stock file at all (BMS reads them; they simply are not listed).
Groups are matched against the option name in the order they appear here, first hit wins.

g_fCursorSpeed.text: How fast the mouse cursor moves in the 3D cockpit.

g_bMFDHighContrast.text: Draws the MFD pages in higher contrast, which reads more easily on some monitors.

g_fRadarScale.text: Size of the radar symbology on the MFD.

g_bHSD_HAD_FCR_Font.text: Uses the sharper font for the HSD, HAD and FCR pages.

g_fHADSymbolSize.text: Size of the symbols drawn on the HAD page.

g_fHSDSymbolSize.text: Size of the symbols drawn on the HSD page.

g_bBarcapNoBarcap.text: Stops the campaign tasking BARCAP flights against BARCAPs.

g_bNoDTCForRampStart.text: Does not load the DTC automatically on a ramp start, so you load it yourself from the cockpit.

g_nPrintToFile.text: Where PRINT on the briefing screen sends the briefing: 0 printer, 1 a text file, 2 both.

g_bAppendToBriefingFile.text: Adds each printed briefing to the end of the file instead of replacing it.

g_bBriefHTML.text: Prints the briefing as HTML as well as text.

g_bEnableDisplacementCam.text: Lets the cockpit view shift with g-force and airframe movement.

g_b3DClickableCursorAnchored.text: Keeps the clickable-cockpit cursor anchored rather than free-moving.

g_fDefaultFOV.text: The field of view the 3D cockpit opens at, in degrees.

g_bFullScreenNVG.text: Night vision fills the whole screen instead of only the goggle circles.

g_bNoPadlockBoxes.text: Stops drawing the box around a padlocked target.

g_bPngScreenshots.text: Saves screenshots as PNG rather than JPEG.

g_bPlayIntroMovie.text: Plays the intro movie when BMS starts.

g_bRampTaxiStart.text: Starts you at the ramp ready to taxi rather than cold and dark.

g_bCalibrationHg.text: Altimeter calibration in inches of mercury rather than hectopascals.

g_nFairCloudRestriction.text: Restricts missions flown in fair-weather cloud conditions.

g_nPoorInclCloudRestriction.text: Restricts missions flown in poor or inclement cloud conditions.

g_bHotasDgftSelfCancel.text: The dogfight switch cancels itself when moved back, rather than latching.

g_bUseVirtualRudder.text: Gives you a virtual rudder when no rudder axis is bound.

g_bHiResTextures.text: Loads the high resolution texture set.

g_bUseAnalogIdleCutoff.text: Treats the throttle idle cutoff as an analogue position rather than a button.

g_bReducePSFires.text: Draws fewer particles for fires, which costs less performance.

g_bEnvironmentMapping.text: Reflections on aircraft and cockpit surfaces.

g_bHdrLightingStar.text: The star-shaped glare HDR puts around bright lights.

g_bShowFarRain.text: Draws rain in the distance as well as close in.

g_bShadowMapping.text: Shadows cast by aircraft and objects.

g_bShadowOnSmoke.text: Lets shadows fall across smoke, which is costly.

g_bEnvMapRenderFocusObject.text: Includes your own aircraft in the reflections.

g_bExternalTrackIR.text: Lets TrackIR drive the external views as well as the cockpit.

g_bInvertExternalTrackIR.text: Inverts TrackIR in the external views.

g_bAllowMP_Freeze.text: Host: allows players to use the freeze function.

g_bRequireSameAcdataMP.text: Host: every client must have identical aircraft data.

g_bRequireSameTileSetMP.text: Host: every client must have the same terrain tile set.

g_nMPStartRestricted.text: Host: restricts which start types players may choose.

g_sTexturesLODPreset.text: Texture detail preset the game loads at.

extra.t: Ambient light bounced onto surfaces. Costly, and one of the biggest visual differences.
Ambient highlights on shiny surfaces.
Includes the terrain in reflections.
Gives runways and tarmac real depth rather than a flat texture.
Pushes the distance at which objects drop to a simpler model. Higher costs more.
Renders terrain and objects above or below screen resolution. Above 1.0 is supersampling.
How large the MFD pages are drawn before being put on the screen. Larger is sharper and costs more.
Lets lights on the ground cast onto the terrain at night.
How finely the terrain mesh is divided. Higher is smoother ground and costs more.
Uses the larger procedural textures on the terrain.
Forces 4K photoreal tiles instead of the 16K set where one exists.
How strongly the terrain bump mapping shows, 0 to 1.
Fixed foveated rendering: draws the edges of the VR image at lower detail to save performance.
How much of the middle of the VR image is kept at full detail.
Keeps the clickable-cockpit cursor in the middle of the screen.
Streams live telemetry that Tacview — and BMS Companion's AWACS picture and taxi traffic — read.
Records the flight to an ACMI file for replay.
How long, in ms, a shifted HOTAS press counts as a quick press.
How many buttons BMS reads from each device. The launcher usually sets this.
Adds the tail number to aircraft labels.
Accepts input from any mouse rather than the system one only.
